# Archive admission fixtures

`example-pack` and `color-tools` are unchanged copies of the registry service's
`fixtures/packs` at commit `84a62ae10c257f00f1c5b737a130a41ee227b54b`.
The contract tests preserve their archive admission metadata, doctor findings
and executable schema signatures. Public CI needs no service checkout or
credentials. Operator timings and diagnostic paths are not stable contracts.
